method: Public map geometry plus browser inspection of the owner plan and linked exterior photographs; no reference image pixels embedded in the asset.

sources.observed: Long narrow precinct, northern entrance, two open courts, central keep and southern main palace.
Palas courtyard facade has paired lower arches, grouped round-headed windows, carved columns and blind arcaded cornices beneath the green roof.
Sandstone keep with pale quoins, crenellated crown and small green canopy below the gold cross; steep copper Palas gable roof and sculptural lions.
White square South Tower with pale quoins and battlements, inclined covered timber stair; half-timbered Gadem with tall slate roof.
White-and-dark timber Vogtei, half-hipped tile roof and projecting Gothic oriel with green polygonal cap.
Owner records a 3.80 m cross with gilded copper cladding on a timber core.

identity: Exact Q151545 node/2272817622; component way polygons in map-parts.json. No exact-identity occupied precinct polygon asserted.
limits: Vertical measurements are reconstructed. The owner description of a nearly 34 m keep conflicts with 40–46 m OSM tags. Model top is provisionally 34 m including 3.8 m cross. Ground levels, carved sculpture, exact window patterns, half-hip and Gadem roof junctions are not yet maximum-fidelity verified. The 1857 cork model is not used as present-day geometry because the owner describes unbuilt proposals in it.
